stem: Imran asks how many $3$-digit counting numbers there are.

options.text: There are $900$ three-digit counting numbers, from $100$ to $999$.
There are $999$ three-digit counting numbers, counting every whole number from $1$ to $999$.
A $3$-digit number has digit length $3$, so there are exactly $3$ such numbers.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Three-digit counting numbers run from 100 to 999, and 999 − 100 + 1 = 900.

teacher.key_rationale: 3-digit counting numbers are 100 through 999, so 900 of them. Counting from 1 to 999 omits the 3-digit start. Equating digit length 3 with a count of 3 swaps the length label for the tally.
